articles.title: In 2022, 'Love Is Blind' couple Nick and Vanessa Lachey sold their L.A. home to tennis star Naomi Osaka, and in 2025, they repurchased it from her; now, less than a year later, they list it again for $8.2 million
articles.description: Nick and Vanessa Lachey are selling their Tarzana estate for $8.195 million after repurchasing it from Naomi Osaka. Previously, they bought the property from former NFL player Randall Cobb for around $5.05 million. Osaka made significant renovations to the estate during her ownership, enhancing its appeal. The couple returned to California after cancelling their CBS series, NCIS: Hawai’i, and decided to sell the home again.
